title: NBI refers 4 Davao flood control cases to DOJ
summary: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has referred four cases involving alleged irregularities in flood control projects in Davao to the Department of Justice (DOJ) for appropriate action, while…

blocks.text: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has referred four cases involving alleged irregularities in flood control projects in Davao to the Department of Justice (DOJ) for appropriate action, while investigations into projects in Bulacan and other district offices remain ongoing.
